items.definition:
traditional stories
The region is rich in local folklore.

great delight
He jumped with glee when he heard the news.

sound of a gun firing
We heard a gunshot in the distance.

a house and land
The family built their homestead near the river.

A unit of power.
The car engine produced 300 horsepower.

A color or shade.
The painting featured a beautiful hue of blue.

The ability to think and understand.
Her sharp intellect impressed everyone.

A road junction where traffic can move between different roads without crossing.
We took the exit at the next interchange.

A temporary failure of concentration, memory, or judgment.
He had a momentary lapse of concentration during the exam.

A book or computer file in which a company's accounts are recorded.
All transactions are recorded in the company's ledger.

A chemical element, a light silvery-white metal.
Magnesium is an important mineral for the human body.

The expression of criticism or pessimism.
Try to avoid negativity and focus on the positive.

a chemical to kill pests
Farmers use pesticide to protect their crops.

a sudden, forceful dive or fall
He took a refreshing plunge into the cold lake.

a factory that refines raw materials
The oil refinery processes crude oil into gasoline.

the state of being mentally sound
He questioned his own sanity after the long ordeal.

a final confrontation
The two rivals prepared for a final showdown.

a short, dragging walk; a mix
He walked with a slow shuffle.

material covering the exterior of a house
The house needed new siding after the storm.

a large, flat piece of stone or wood
They laid a concrete slab for the new patio.

a style of electronic dance music
He loves listening to techno music at clubs.

a state of altered consciousness
She fell into a deep trance during the meditation.

a type of delivery in cricket
The bowler delivered a perfect yorker.

ammunition
The soldier ran out of ammo.

a collection of literary works
The anthology includes poems from various authors.

a person who conducts an audit
The company hired an independent auditor.

a mass of snow, ice, and rocks falling rapidly down a mountainside
The skiers were caught in an avalanche.

playful and friendly exchange of teasing remarks
There was a lot of friendly banter among the teammates.

a person who makes a bid
The highest bidder won the auction.

a film, book, or product that is a great commercial success
The new superhero movie is a real blockbuster.

a detailed plan or design
They developed a blueprint for the new building.

a small role played by a famous actor; a piece of jewelry
The director made a brief cameo in his own film.

a beginning or start; a graduation ceremony
The university held its annual commencement ceremony.

the process of corroding metal, stone, or other materials
Rust is a common form of corrosion on metal.

open resistance; bold disobedience
His act of defiance against the rules was noted.

the end of the period for which something is valid; the act of breathing out
Check the expiration date on the milk carton.

the power to fascinate; the state of being fascinated
She had a lifelong fascination with ancient Egypt.

a slope or a rate of change
The road had a steep gradient.

a person or thing that hops; a container
The grain was loaded into the hopper.

the central theme or a main speech
The CEO delivered the keynote address at the conference.

a Tibetan Buddhist spiritual teacher or a South American camelid
The Dalai Lama is a spiritual leader.

the loss of the ability to move
The accident caused temporary paralysis in his legs.

a person who journeys to a sacred place for religious reasons
The pilgrims traveled a long distance to reach the holy site.

a kick in football where the ball is dropped and kicked before it hits the ground; a flat-bottomed boat
The team decided to punt the ball on fourth down.

a bird of prey; a type of dinosaur
The eagle is a powerful raptor.

the action or process of reinforcing or strengthening
The bridge needed reinforcement to withstand the strong winds.

the skin covering the head, excluding the face
She massaged her scalp with shampoo.

a person who thinks deeply
She is a deep thinker, always questioning things.

a level quayside area to which a ship may be moored to load and unload
The fishing boats were tied up at the old wharf.

the lowest female singing voice or highest male singing voice
She sings alto in the choir.

each of the twelve chief disciples of Jesus Christ
Peter was one of the twelve apostles.

a system of training a new generation of practitioners of a trade or profession
He started an apprenticeship to become an electrician.

the distance or measurement from side to side; wide range
The breadth of his knowledge is impressive.

a small waterfall, typically one of several that fall in stages down a steep rocky slope
We hiked to see the beautiful cascade of water.

connection; joining
The coupling between the two train cars was secure.

the process of performing scientific experiments
Scientific progress often relies on careful experimentation.

a person who holds extreme political or religious views
The group was condemned as a collection of dangerous extremists.

a sudden and disturbing vivid memory of an event in the past
The movie used a flashback to explain the character's past.

an irregular rising and falling in number or amount; a variation
We observed a significant fluctuation in temperature throughout the day.

a shiny surface or appearance
The car had a high-gloss finish.

a silence or quiet
A sudden hush fell over the crowd.

the action of immersing someone or something in a liquid; deep mental involvement
Language learning through full immersion is very effective.

a mass of earth or rock sliding rapidly down a mountain or cliff; an overwhelming victory
The election was a landslide victory for the incumbent party.

Liquid Crystal Display
My new monitor uses an LCD screen.
